summary.intent: Execute gate 5 of the desktop hardware-gate testing plan — a feasibility spike proving whether Apple's new FSKit framework (macOS 27 beta) can provide reliable push-invalidation cache coherence for the desktop client's filesystem backend, per issue #644.
summary.outcome: Built a native FSKit module via runtime introspection (no public headers/Xcode needed), got it mounting on macOS 27 beta, and empirically confirmed `setCacheStateForItem` with coherencyAction=1/2 reliably invalidates cached mmap pages (100/100, sub-millisecond latency). Documented findings and updated blueprint/testing docs, but the 19-file gate-5 commit failed to push due to a 1Password SSH signing agent issue and was still unresolved (retry in progress) when the user asked to merge PR #736.

repo: Gates 1-4 (and now gate 5) in tools/hw-gates are task-shaped spike work with recorded RESULTS.md, not CI-gated — they intentionally don't get a CodeRabbit/review cycle

Commits in this repo are SSH-signed via a 1Password agent; project convention is to never bypass signing (--no-gpg-sign) without explicit user authorization, even when the agent has no loaded identity
markdownlint (pre-commit hook) rejects fenced code blocks without a language tag, and commitlint rejects parenthesized text in commit subject lines
Repro/blueprint docs to keep in sync when a gate result changes: tools/hw-gates/RESULTS.md (parent), blueprint/desktop.md, blueprint/testing.md

code.finding: loadResource must set FSContainerStatus to 'ready' (not 'active') or mount fails with EPROTONOSUPPORT (43); 'active' is only for after volumes are already mounted

swiftc's synthesized `@main` entry point crashes on macOS 27 beta (MainActor.assumeIsolated trap); must keep @main for ExtensionKit discovery metadata (__swift5_entry) but force the Mach-O link entry to `_NSExtensionMain` instead, matching how fuse-t's working module enters

setCacheStateForItem with coherencyAction=1 or 2 invalidates cached mmap pages (100% reliable, p50~0.35-1.15ms, p95~0.44-2.22ms); actions 0 and 3 are no-ops; invalidation transitions the vnode to a persistent no-cache coherency state, so measurements require a fresh vnode per trial to avoid false negatives from vnode reuse

Enabling a third-party FSKit module programmatically requires the private com.apple.private.LiveFS.connection entitlement; in production this is replaced by the user-facing System Settings > File System Extensions toggle

workflow: Runtime introspection (dumping ObjC metadata/selectors/type encodings from the FSKit dylib in the dyld shared cache) was used successfully to recover an undocumented beta API surface (FSVolumeDataCacheHandler) with no public headers available yet

Disabling SIP + amfi_get_out_of_my_way=1 boot-arg on a VM was used purely as a signing workaround for ad-hoc-signed restricted-entitlement binaries during the spike; not required in production where proper Developer cert signing satisfies AMFI
When unified log streaming during a mount test gets clobbered by stray background log streamers, kill all streamers first and do one clean, tightly-scoped capture script

friction: Long trial-and-error loop instrumenting FSKit's undocumented beta APIs via binary reverse engineering (exports, ObjC metadata, type encodings) since no public headers existed yet
Extension crashed on startup due to swiftc's default @main entry conflicting with ExtensionKit's expected NSExtensionMain entry — required Mach-O entry point surgery
Non-reproducible invalidation results initially traced to vnode reuse across test runs leaving stale no-cache state, requiring a redesign to use fresh vnodes per trial
Mount kept failing with cryptic errno codes (EDEVERR, EPROTONOSUPPORT) requiring redacted-log workarounds and scoped log capture scripts to get real diagnostic info

1Password SSH signing agent had no loaded identity, causing the signed git commit to fail silently/hard-fail, leaving 19 files staged-but-uncommitted and initially unnoticed until the user was about to merge the PR
open_items: Gate-5 commit (19 files) still not confirmed pushed to chore/desktop-hw-gates / PR #736 as of end of transcript — retry was in progress pending 1Password agent unlock
